status.en: 16 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 46% more than the week before, most of them in Bangkok, Chiang Rai and Phuket.
status.nb: 16 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 46 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Bangkok, Chiang Rai og Phuket.

summary.en: Recent bomb blasts in Satun injured three students and prompted police to step up border security in multiple provinces, while Perlis authorities tightened vigilance after the attacks. Thai forces scrambled F-16s to the Tak border as clashes in Myanmar spilled across the frontier, and Thailand placed ten border provinces on alert and prepared evacuation centres for potential refugees. Talks began between Thailand and Myanmar to address arsenic-tainted rivers, and Mae Sai residents demanded action on cross-border water contamination. The insurgency killed an insurgent trainer and a suspect in Yala operations near Malaysia, and another insurgent was killed in a separate Yala action. 35 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

background.title: Southern Thailand insurgency
background.extract: The Southern Thailand insurgency is an ongoing conflict centered in southern Thailand. It originated in 1948 as a separatist insurgency in the historical Malay Patani Region, made up of the three southernmost provinces of Thailand and parts of a fourth, but has become more complex and increasingly violent since the early 2000s from drug cartels, oil smuggling networks, and sometimes pirate raids.
background.extractNb: Opprøret i Sør-Thailand er en pågående konflikt mellom thailandske styrker og islamistiske separatistgrupper, i de tre sørligste provinsene i Thailand. Volden sprer seg også i økt grad over til andre provinser. Selv om separatistene riktignok har opptrådt voldelig i flere tiår, eskalerte kampanjen deres i 2004.
